name: @tocharianou/cloudtrail-mcp

tools.name: lookup_events
tools.description: Look up CloudTrail management events for the last 90 days. Filter by time range, username, event name, access key, resource name/type, or event source. Supports pagination. Ideal for security investigations, auditing IAM actions, and tracing API calls.

startTime.description: Start time for event lookup. Accepts ISO format ("2025-01-01T00:00:00Z") or relative ("1 day ago", "2 hours ago"). Defaults to "1 day ago". IMPORTANT: When paginating (nextToken), must match the original request exactly.

endTime.description: End time for event lookup. Accepts ISO format or relative ("now"). Defaults to "now". IMPORTANT: When paginating (nextToken), must match the original request exactly.

attributeKey.description: Filter attribute key. One of: EventId, EventName, ReadOnly, Username, ResourceType, ResourceName, EventSource, AccessKeyId.

attributeValue.description: Value to match for the specified attributeKey.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of events to return (1–50, default: 10).

nextToken.description: Pagination token from a previous lookup_events response. When provided, startTime and endTime must match the original request.

region.description: AWS region to query (e.g. us-east-1). Defaults to AWS_DEFAULT_REGION or us-east-1.

break_token_rule.description: Set to true to bypass token limits in critical situations (default: false)

tools.name: lake_query
tools.description: Execute a Trino-compatible SQL SELECT query against CloudTrail Lake for advanced analytics and filtering beyond the 90-day LookupEvents limit. Supports complex aggregations, joins, and long-term historical analysis. Requires a valid Event Data Store ID in the FROM clause.

sql.description: SQL SELECT statement to execute against CloudTrail Lake using Trino-compatible syntax. Must reference a valid Event Data Store (EDS) ID in the FROM clause. Use list_event_data_stores to get available EDS IDs first. Example: SELECT eventname, sourceipaddress FROM <eds-id> WHERE eventtime > '2025-01-01 00:00:00' LIMIT 10

waitForCompletion.description: Wait for query to finish and return results (default: true). Set to false to submit asynchronously and poll with get_query_status.

region.description: AWS region to query. Defaults to AWS_DEFAULT_REGION or us-east-1.

break_token_rule.description: Set to true to bypass token limits in critical situations (default: false)

tools.name: get_query_status
tools.description: Check the execution status of a CloudTrail Lake query (QUEUED, RUNNING, FINISHED, FAILED, CANCELLED, TIMED_OUT). Use after submitting an async lake_query to determine when results are ready.

queryId.description: The CloudTrail Lake query ID returned by lake_query.

region.description: AWS region where the query was submitted. Defaults to AWS_DEFAULT_REGION or us-east-1.

break_token_rule.description: Set to true to bypass token limits in critical situations (default: false)

tools.name: get_query_results
tools.description: Retrieve the results of a completed CloudTrail Lake query with pagination support. Fetch successive pages using the nextToken returned from each response.

queryId.description: The CloudTrail Lake query ID to retrieve results for (status must be FINISHED).

maxResults.description: Maximum rows to return per page (1–50, default: 50).

nextToken.description: Pagination token from a previous get_query_results response.

region.description: AWS region where the query was submitted. Defaults to AWS_DEFAULT_REGION or us-east-1.

break_token_rule.description: Set to true to bypass token limits in critical situations (default: false)

tools.name: list_event_data_stores
tools.description: List all CloudTrail Lake Event Data Stores in the specified region with their ARNs, status, retention period, and optional event selector details. Run this first to get the EDS ID required for lake_query SQL statements.

includeDetails.description: Include detailed event selector and multi-region configuration per store (default: true).

region.description: AWS region to query. Defaults to AWS_DEFAULT_REGION or us-east-1.

break_token_rule.description: Set to true to bypass token limits in critical situations (default: false)
